claims.claim: Ibc tank for storage of water or any liquid very strong and durable
claims.evidence: Witness report shows IBC cube tanks with metal cages and a label reading “EMMALINK CONCEPT NIG”, but does not confirm water/chemical suitability, prior contents, sealing condition, or durability/strength.

risks.risk: Unknown grade/previous contents (food-grade vs chemical-grade) and whether it is safe for water use
risks.proof: A clear photo of the IBC label/markings showing grade/previous chemical compatibility (e.g., food-grade/UN markings) and any cleaning/sanitization proof.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not confirmed for potable water; treated as general-purpose/unknown-use IBC.

risks.risk: Leaks, cracks, or damage to the plastic bladder and/or metal cage
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the entire cage and all sides of the plastic bladder plus a quick water-fill/pressure test clip (or at least a leak-check clip).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially needing inspection/possible repair; worst-case assumed minor damage risk.

risks.risk: Cap/valve/seal condition (round black cap on top) may not seal properly
risks.proof: Video clip showing the cap/valve area, including opening/closing and a simple seal test (no drips) or a tightness check.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as may not seal reliably; treated as requiring replacement/repair of cap/valve.

risks.risk: Capacity/size rating not confirmed (liters) and whether all units match
risks.proof: Photo of the capacity/size rating on each IBC (or a label close-up) showing liters and matching model/ratings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest likely capacity among common IBC sizes and assumed units may not all match.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged taps/spigots (not shown) and whether they are included and functional
risks.proof: Photos of the bottom outlet/tap/spigot area for each unit, plus a clip showing flow when opened.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as without confirmed functional spigots; treated as needing spigot/tap replacement if absent.

risks.risk: Quantity of complete usable units not confirmed (some may be incomplete or unusable)
risks.proof: A count shot showing all units clearly and confirming each has intact cage, cap/valve, and no visible damage.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming only the foreground unit is fully usable; background units treated as uncertain until counted and inspected.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the full IBC label/markings (grade/UN/food-grade or chemical compatibility) for the foreground tank and any others.
Photos of all sides of the plastic bladder and the entire metal cage (including corners and base).
Video showing the cap/valve area: open/close and a leak-check (no drips).
Photo of the capacity rating (liters) on the label for each unit.
Photos and a short clip of the bottom outlet/tap/spigot area showing it is present and functional.
A clear count photo/video showing how many complete usable IBC units are included.
response.reason: The witness confirms the item type and brand label, but key factors that drive price in Rivers (grade/previous contents, leak/damage, valve sealing, spigot presence, exact capacity, and usable quantity) are not shown. Without those proof points, a worst-case price would be unreliable.
